# Imagic 2.0.0

Imagic 2.0 turns the Laravel Nova image field into a complete, owner-scoped
image workflow: upload, crop, transform, organize, reuse, and safely store media
on local or cloud disks.

## Highlights

- A responsive Nova media library with per-user uploads, nested folders,
  search, filters, sorting, pagination, reuse, rename, move, and guarded bulk
  deletion.
- Rebuilt single and multiple fields with reliable previews, keyboard and drag
  reordering, media-library selection, and interactive crop-before-upload.
- S3 and S3-compatible writes through Laravel Storage, with random object names,
  originals/thumbnails, and rollback when a batch fails.
- Stable `media:<uuid>` values that resolve to owner-authorized Nova previews
  without exposing private storage paths.
- Strict MIME, extension, byte-size, dimension, pixel-count, and batch limits,
  plus authenticated, rate-limited, owner-scoped media routes.
- A current security-maintained baseline of PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12, Nova 5, and
  Intervention Image 3.11+. The broader PHP 8.1+, Laravel 9–11, Nova 4–5, and
  Intervention Image 2.7/3.11+ combinations exist only for EOL migration
  compatibility.

## Before upgrading

Version 2.0 is a major release:

- PHP 7 is no longer supported.
- Run `php artisan migrate` to create the media catalog.
- New uploads are private by default; public storage requires an explicit
  configuration or `->visibility('public')` override.
- Managed uploads persist as `media:<uuid>` references. Legacy URL/path and JSON
  values remain readable but are not automatically imported into the catalog.
- Intervention Image 3 is recommended; 2.7 remains a transition path.

> [!WARNING]
> Composer may refuse a fresh legacy resolution because active framework
> advisories have no patched release on those lines. Do not disable Composer
> security blocking in a production application to install Imagic. Upgrade the
> application stack; the CI-only legacy override exists solely to detect Imagic
> regressions.

Read the complete [upgrade guide](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/blob/v2.0.0/UPGRADE.md)
before updating production.

```bash
composer require ayvazyan10/nova-imagic:^2.0 --with-all-dependencies
php artisan migrate
```

This release addresses the live-crop, collision-resistant filename, S3 upload,
and multiple-image rendering reports tracked in
[#3](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/issues/3),
[#4](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/issues/4),
[#5](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/issues/5), and
[#6](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/issues/6). It supersedes the
partial URL-only approach in
[#7](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/pull/7).

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md)
and [security policy](https://github.com/ayvazyan10/nova-imagic/blob/v2.0.0/SECURITY.md).
